headline: Siemens EDA presents a digital-centric mixed-signal verification workshop
fact: At DVCon U.S. on February 27, 2023, Siemens EDA presented a workshop describing digital-centric mixed-signal verification methods. Its program covers real-number modeling, constrained-random verification, assertions, functional coverage, formal techniques, low-power verification, and automated debug; the evidence documents vendor methodology advocacy rather than customer adoption.
